column3: Setup: Use the journal_form testdrive - its primary_journal has no owner-transfer history (shows 'Last Owner Transfer: Never'), and publisher_transfer_target is a second publisher account to transfer ownership to. Run the test in a separate tab, leaving the testdrive tab open.
Log in as admin_1 from the testdrive setup, then go to admin journal search page at /admin/journals
Locate the primary_journal (its metadata shows 'Last Owner Transfer: Never') and click 'Edit this journal'
Locate the "Re-assign publisher account" section of the form
Change the user to publisher_transfer_target from the testdrive setup
close the journal form and go back to the admin search page
Refresh the search and locate the journal you just edited

column4: The "Last Owner Transfer" field displays the current date and time

column3: Click "Edit this journal" and go to the admin form

column4: There is a note attached to the record indicating the previous and new owner and the date and time of the transfer
